titulo: Staff Validation Systems Engineer, AI Validation
descripcion_html:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s engineering teams are building the AI, robotics, simulation, data, and systems foundations needed to deploy a generalisable AI Driver safely and at scale.

About AI Validation

The AI Validation team develops the strategies, evidence, metrics, and test systems that build confidence in the Wayve AI Driver. Both locations translate ambiguous product and safety questions into validation plans, scenarios, metrics, coverage, acceptance criteria, and evidence for release decisions—but the product scope and candidate profile differ by location.

This role focuses primarily on ADAS and L2 autonomy functions. It works closely with automotive and OEM expectations, including product, customer, safety, and regulatory requirements. The role can be hired as a TC4 individual contributor or an M4 manager with responsibility for technical direction and team delivery.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Translate product, systems, and safety requirements into validation strategies, test scenarios, metrics, coverage requirements, and acceptance criteria.

  • Work hands-on with Python, evaluation pipelines, test implementation, simulation, and data analysis.

  • Analyse results and communicate findings, risks, and evidence to Product, Safety, Release, and Autonomy Engineering stakeholders.

  • Coordinate data, simulation, and evaluation dependencies so validation can run reliably and at scale.

  • Develop comprehensive verification strategies for ADAS and L2 autonomy functions.

  • Translate customer, OEM, safety, and regulatory expectations into practical validation evidence.

  • Build test suites spanning simulation and physical testing environments.

  • At M4, provide people leadership and coordinate validation delivery across the team; at TC4, provide senior technical ownership as an individual contributor.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • ADAS functions such as lane keeping and other assisted-driving capabilities.

  • Validation strategies aligned with automotive OEM development, customer expectations, SOTIF, and emerging AV-industry standards.

  • Simulated and physical test environments, comprehensive coverage, and evidence-based release decisions.

  • Python-based evaluation tooling, SQL and scalable data analysis, behavioural metrics, test coverage, and automated validation execution.

🙌 You should apply if

  • You understand how automotive companies and OEMs develop and validate ADAS or L2 autonomy products.

  • You can translate customer, safety, regulatory, and product expectations into structured validation strategies.

  • You have hands-on experience building scenarios, metrics, test suites, evaluation pipelines, or data-analysis workflows.

  • You can use Python professionally and are comfortable with SQL or similar large-scale analysis tools.

  • You have validated complex systems in simulation, the real world, or both.

  • You communicate clearly, document decisions well, and can own ambiguous problems from concept through evidence and recommendation.

  • ML, computer vision, motion planning, SOTIF, safety validation, or modern AI-tooling experience is advantageous.

  • For the M4 scope, you have experience leading people or coordinating a validation function; for TC4, you bring strong senior individual-contributor ownership.


🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2+ through to L4.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working

This role is based in London. We operate a hybrid model combining in-person collaboration in our offices and workshops with focused time working remotely.

🔍 The Interview Process

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (25 min)

  • Hiring Manager Screen (60 min)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews covering systems and domain expertise (4 hours)

  • Final interview focused on mission and values alignment (60 min)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (location dependent)

  • 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

  • 📈 Meaningful equity

  • ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

  • ✅ Hybrid working and hands-on access to workshops and labs

  • 📚 Learning and development support

  • 🩺 Comprehensive location-dependent health, family, retirement, and wellbeing benefits

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.
